reviewContext: President-authorized conversion of the kernel mission and Pre-scale Gate from chat-dependent guidance into deterministic machine-readable self-diagnostics that reduce repeated AI reasoning and warn on mission drift before further scaling
reviewedSemantics: the kernel mission is now executable policy rather than chat-only memory
known policy checks are deterministic-first and AI is reserved for ambiguous semantics, optimization alternatives and novel capability abstraction
proposal preflight uses SETKA_CHANGE_PROPOSAL_V1 and returns ALIGNED, OPTIMIZE, REVIEW_REQUIRED or BLOCK with deterministic signals and optimization hints
protected kernel drift is routed through MISSION_GATE in Kernel Pulse and the workflow now watches the mission document, mission policy and mission gate implementation
the mission gate self-test passed all 5 cases in run 33673846509
the existing kernel handshake self-test remained PASS with 8 cases in run 33673846509

run 33673846509 produced an OPTIMIZE warning for NEW_PERMANENT_KERNEL_MASS exactly as intended; this review accepts the two new operational files because they replace repeated human/AI mission re-derivation with a reusable deterministic guard
the mission gate does not automatically delete ideas; OPTIMIZE is a compiler hint toward connector, hybrid, smaller primitive, causal derivation or better benchmark definition

hard BLOCK remains limited to known prohibited semantics such as silent history rewrite, bypass of cryosleep/recovery gates, unbounded dense deterministic writes or persisting proven derived noise as canonical data
the mission document itself is now protected kernel governance surface so future mission changes require review
no replay_math, storage_write or runtime_safety implementation changed in this transition
PostgreSQL/Supabase was not modified; cryosleep and all recovery gates remain authoritative
